entries.clue: Flint's title, and the one whose word is law on a ship's quarterdeck
Chemical mist blown through the rows to hold the scab off
Green bird of Long John's, screeching the same three words for ever
Plier-like grippers the dentist uses to lever stubborn teeth out of their sockets
Pole projecting ahead of the hull, to which the foremost sails are set
Cider county of Taunton, Glastonbury and the flooded Levels
Long unbroken curl pared off an apple and tossed over the shoulder
Tooth-coloured resin, shade-matched then set hard by a blue light
The top half of a set of false teeth, the one that grips the palate
One who feeds a crew, and the post a one-legged schemer signed on under
Gurgling little tube hooked over the lip to draw saliva away mid-treatment
Dwarfing base a chosen variety is worked onto, fixing the tree's size
